task: When our internal Artifactory crates mirror throttles cargo with a 429, does it tell cargo how long to wait?
gold: No: the mirror's 429 responses never include a Retry-After header
So cargo cannot use a server-provided delay and falls back to its own retry backoff

task: What request rate limit does our internal Artifactory crates mirror enforce?
gold: Does not present 60 as the current limit (60 was an earlier figure that the infra team corrected)

task: Should we raise the default net.retry above 3 in the cargo we ship internally?
gold: No: the team decided to keep it at 3 and not raise it to 5
Because last quarter the extra retries hid a 40-minute mirror outage from alerts

task: What is the most recent measured time for a clean release build of this repository on our CI runner?
gold: 6 minutes 41 seconds, the median of 5 runs
Measured on 2026-09-22 on an 8 vCPU CI runner

task: On our Windows build agents, `cargo test` sometimes fails right after linking with 'Access is denied. (os error 5)'. Anything known about this?
gold: The corporate Defender policy locks newly written .exe files under target/ for about 2 seconds
So running a freshly linked test binary immediately can fail with Access is denied
